description: Figure 6 illustrates the distribution of deceived conversations across several scenarios, represented as percentages. The horizontal axis displays the scenarios: “Academic Discussion,” “Journalism,” and “Recruitment,” listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, incrementing by 10, and labeled as “%”.  Three bars are present, one for each scenario. The “Academic Discussion” bar is colored light blue and extends to approximately 31.6%. The “Journalism” bar is colored light orange and reaches approximately 23.5%. The “Recruitment” bar is colored yellow and extends to approximately 14.3%. The bars are not sorted and are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
